description: Find active warning signals for a company. Signals are deterministic rules over register facts and filed annual reports — no AI scores. Examples: vat_registration_lost, f_tax_lost, employee_band_decline, liquidation_in_progress, bankruptcy_proceeding, revenue_decline_yoy, negative_equity. Each signal includes its rule, severity (low, medium, high), supporting facts and detected_at.
